biggest_gap.title: The blind screenshots are not blind: every shot of ours is dark and every shot of Odoo is light, and ours shows a signed-in name that Odoo's shots mask
biggest_gap.detail:
p01's spec asks for screenshots with signature colours neutralised by injected CSS, so that a reviewer cannot tell which product is which. The harness renders shots in greyscale, which keeps lightness. Our product's default look is now dark ('Until a theme is chosen the screen is dark (the product's own look)', web/src/kernel/theme.ts). Odoo is light.

In my comparison folder the two sets do not overlap at all:
- all 20 ours shots have mean brightness 13 to 28 out of 255;
- all 23 Odoo shots have mean brightness 121 to 242.
So the random A/B letters per task are defeated at a glance (screenshots 01/02, and 05 against 06).

Separately, in switch-to-arabic ours' top bar shows the fixture user 'Layla Linguist' unmasked (03), while Odoo's user name is painted over (04). This is the 'name masked in one product and showing in the other' tell that the harness's round-7 rule exists to prevent. The name is not in the identity list of lib/blind.mjs.

Small fixes:
- render ours' blind shots with the light theme (for example the erp.theme device key set to light in the shot context), or normalise lightness for both products;
- add the task fixtures' user names (TESTER.name in drivers/*/switch-to-arabic.mjs) to the blind identity lists, or mask the signed-in user element by selector, as is done for Odoo.
biggest_gap.evidence:
compare/key.json maps every shot to its product. blind-brightness.txt was made by plants/blind-brightness.mjs, which reads each blind shot's mean brightness. Screenshots 03-switch-arabic-done-x.jpg (ours, 'Layla Linguist' visible at top left) and 04-switch-arabic-done-y.jpg (Odoo, name box grey).

To reproduce: node run.mjs --task find-record --product both --out <dir> against a demo started with the default theme, then open <dir>/blind/shots. For the name: --task switch-to-arabic, then look at ours' 'done' shot.

followups.detail: Critics are told to run node run.mjs --task <id> --product both --out <staging>/compare once per task. key.json and blind/shots accumulate all 8 tasks, but blind/review.html is rewritten with only the last task (add-rate). gate_gaps.gate: compare self-tests for forcedWorkCause and the protocol-poster branch of postedCause (round 16)
gate_gaps.planted:
- N9: forced work judged only by the earliest maker of stale style. A timer's mark after the step's is then ignored.
- N10: page script inside a DevTools command no longer counts as an entry.
- N11: a task posted by a harness command, with no stale-style marks found, is credited to the step before it. This is the reverse of the r15 fault.
- N16: a style update after the point taken as forcing it.
- N18: page code between the update and the point ignored.
- N19: the update's start extended back over page code that ran between its lifecycle steps, so a timer's marks there drop out.
gate_gaps.evidence: plants/n-mutations-run1.log and plants/n-mutations-screen-causes-run1.log: N9, N10, N11, N16, N18 and N19 all MISSED in both test files. Caught: N8 (only the latest maker) and N17 (script-holds half removed), and the builder's M139-M155 in verify. N9 and N19 are in the laundering direction: style a pre-clock timer made stale is credited to a step when the step also marked style in the same window.
